You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

opens.openerLine: "You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before? Be kind to yourself, okay?"
"About what you did with your hands — You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"I hate to ask this, but I can't shake it. I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Will you help me?"
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
Erin: "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
"Can we talk?" Joyce sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Rosa doesn't wait for an answer. "We need to discuss how things are run here."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Can I tell you something? I'm keeping a photo of someone I left behind. I haven't told anyone."
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
Erin: "Don't just stand there — you've got opinions, right?"
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"About your first memory — What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing, friend."
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that. How are you holding up, though?"
"Can we talk?" Erin sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About who you left behind — Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first. It'll pass."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. …if that makes sense."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Hey — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"About what day it is — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"About what day it is — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago. I don't know, though."
"I hate to ask this, but I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Will you help me?"
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"About that news I was bursting to share — You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline."
"About that news I was bursting to share — Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first. But what do I know."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it. Anyway — how are YOU doing?"
"About that news I was bursting to share — Okay, so — something happened this morning. Allegedly."
"About who you don't trust — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"About the funniest thing you've seen — Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Can I tell you something? I know who took the extra rations but won't say. Gotta keep moving."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Bohdan?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. That means something."
"About what you miss most — What do you miss most? From before. Funny how that works."
"Can I tell you something? I'm practicing what I would say if I ever saw my family again. I haven't told anyone."
I want to look it in the eye — whatever it uses for eyes — and get one straight answer.
"Can I trust you? I mean really. Just... be straight with me."
"This cut — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"Good day, huh? Almost feels normal."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here? Not that it matters."
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally? Simple as that."
"Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. — or so they tell me."
"I asked Lamar about the kindest thing someone's done for you — Lamar's gone. What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. Please — have you got anything to spare? Anything? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Can we talk?" Rosa doesn't wait for an answer. "We need to discuss how things are run here."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
Tashi: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"I asked Alessandra about the food I needed — Alessandra's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now? Good talking."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet. Ha. Funny."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there. I mean it."
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. We're down to 8 liters of clean water. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Bohdan — I keep coming back to it. The pods, humming. Do you think they're still in there? Cool, cool."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? Doesn't matter now."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet. That's where we are."
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here, as it were?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I'm sorry — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"I asked Jibon about the creek water run — Jibon's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? Extremely normal, all of it."
"About whether you're staying — Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
I counted the stores twice today. We need more. We always need more.
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. That's the priority."
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Can I tell you something? I've been sneaking out at night. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the north treeline by the fallen oak."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"Can we talk?" Dmitri sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started. No time to waste."
"About your useful old-life skills — What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it, friend?"
"I asked Erin about your useful old-life skills — Erin's gone. What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
Dmitri: "Can I ask you something? ... I want us to stick together. Properly. Watch each other's backs."
"About warn you — I keep turning it over."
"I hate to ask this, but I can't shake it. I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Will you help me?"
"About warn you — I keep turning it over. No pressure, though."
Someday kids will sit by a fire and hear what I did. I want it to be a good one.
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet. Take your time with it."
"...Can I tell you something? I don't actually know how to swim and I'm terrified someone will find out."
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"Now — Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
"About your regrets — Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
You give a lot of orders for someone nobody elected. I'm keeping track. So are others.
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? Anyway, I should move."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them. Good talking."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember. No point pretending otherwise."
"I asked Nikos about needing to be alone — Nikos's gone. Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"Can I tell you something? I've been hiding an injury. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
Rosa: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing. That's the truth of it."
If I understand it, I can survive it. That's the theory, anyway.
Rosa: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
Rosa: "I've heard good things about Emberhold. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
